user.title: Connect to your Sports Tracker
user.description: The address of your self-hosted Sports Tracker, the same one you open in a browser.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach a Sports Tracker at that address. Check that it's running and that Home Assistant can reach it.

abort.already_configured: This tracker is already set up.

init.title: Sports Tracker
init.description: Each team or event you follow gets a scorecard sensor.

team.title: Pick the team
team.description: Type to search. You can also type an ESPN team id.

add_event.title: Follow UFC or NASCAR
add_event.description: The sensor always shows the current or next fight night or race.

recap.title: Scrappy's daily recap
recap.description: Adds a sensor with your account's morning recap. On the Stat Scraps site, open My account, turn on Scrappy's morning recap, and copy the key under Connect other apps. Leave the box empty to remove the sensor.

error.invalid_team: That doesn't look like a team id.
error.invalid_key: The tracker didn't accept that key. Copy it again from My account.

abort.too_many: You can follow up to 20 teams and events per tracker.
